sections.title: The Concept: From ODEs to PDEs
lecture_lines: ODEs track a single variable changing over time.
PDEs describe systems changing in multiple dimensions.
Visualize an ODE path expanding into a PDE surface.
animations: Display title: 'From ODEs to PDEs' in #FFFFFF color.
Fade in a single dot representing an ODE.
Fade in multiple dots representing a PDE.
Draw a connecting line illustrating the transition.
Highlight the transition from single to multi-variable.

sections.title: Visualizing the Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The Heat Equation models temperature diffusion over space.
It shows temperature smoothing out as time progresses.
Visualize this as a surface flattening over time.
animations: Display title: 'Visualizing the Heat Equation' in #FFFFFF color.
Draw a square representing a thermal plate.
Animate heat spreading across the square with color gradient.
Add temperature color bar legend labeled in #FFFF00.

sections.title: The Wave Equation: Vibrations in Motion
lecture_lines: The Wave Equation models oscillations on a string.
It captures how waves move through space and time.
Visualize a sine-wave string vibrating continuously.
animations: Display title: 'The Wave Equation' in #FFFFFF color.
Create a sine wave animation in #00FFFF color.
Animate the wave moving forward in time.
Add a label 'Amplitude' for the wave height.

sections.title: Boundary Conditions: The 'Rules' of the System
lecture_lines: PDEs require boundary conditions to find unique solutions.
Boundary conditions act like rules for the system.
Visualize fixed edges constraining the internal state.
animations: Display title: 'Boundary Conditions' in #FFFFFF color.
Show a square region with fixed borders in #FF00FF.
Animate a wave reflecting off the fixed boundaries.
Add a text label 'Constraint' near the boundary.

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Impact
lecture_lines: PDEs are fundamental to modern science and engineering.
They model aerodynamics, finance, and medical imaging.
They enable advanced technology and scientific discovery.
animations: Display title: 'Summary and Impact' in #FFFFFF color.
